prompt.project_info: Four-image professional fashion photography collage with an authentic behind-the-scenes studio atmosphere and high-end magazine aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman in black tailored trousers and a crisp white formal shirt, with natural skin texture and consistent approved-adult facial structure.
prompt.composition_elements: Four-panel collage of different angles while interacting with a modern wooden chair: seated facing camera with arms over the chair back, standing beside the chair in profile, seated front-facing with hands lowered and a seated editorial pose. Include visible light stands, reflectors and large softbox at the studio edges. Neutral grey seamless backdrop paper curves onto the floor.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large softbox on one side with a rim light behind creating a subtle outline glow, clean shadows and luxury editorial lighting; preserve the authentic BTS studio feel.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-detailed textures, cinematic clarity, professional studio photography, four-panel grid, sharp fabric detail, neutral grey palette and balanced spacing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Upload the supplied reference image and create a four-image collage in a professional fashion photography studio. Show one original approved adult woman with natural skin texture and consistent approved-adult facial structure wearing black tailored trousers and a crisp white formal shirt, posing in different angles while interacting with a modern wooden chair. Include a seated front-facing pose with arms over the chair back, a standing side pose beside the chair, a seated pose with hands lowered and another composed editorial chair pose. The studio setup includes a large softbox on one side, a rim light behind creating a subtle glow outline, visible light stands and reflectors for an authentic behind-the-scenes feel, and neutral grey seamless backdrop paper slightly curved at the floor. Use clean shadows, sharp detailing, luxury editorial lighting, high-end magazine photoshoot aesthetic, ultra-detailed textures and cinematic clarity.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, child, teen, identity drift, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, duplicate chair, cluttered background, unreadable text or logos
